CustomField.description: this is a representation of Status in the event of being conditionally approved by the approver
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(CDE_STATUS__c, 'APV'), Is_Conditionally_Approved__c ), 'Conditionally Approved', CASE( TEXT(CDE_STATUS__c), 'PEN', 'Draft', 'SUB', 'Submitted', 'NRV', 'Need Revision', 'APV', 'Approved', '' ) )
CustomField.label: Status
